headline: Monero Futures Open Interest Crosses $300 Million as Leverage Rises
summary: Derivatives open interest on privacy token Monero exceeded $300 million with prices holding above $600, elevating liquidation and volatility risks as speculative leverage climbed.
why: Elevated leverage in lower-liquidity cryptocurrency futures creates systemic risk of cascading liquidations during sharp market reversals.

impacts.name: Monero
impacts.why: Heavy futures open interest increases susceptibility to sudden short or long squeezes.
